findings.finding: Result currency needs pull request heads Dispatch does not store; attribution only sees merged population pull requests.
findings.answer: Decision 4: new pull_request_heads table written for every pull_request envelope, attributed with attribution.go's functions, a read-through on GET commits/{sha}/pulls at record time, and a 5-minute reconcile of open rows (T7).

findings.answer: Departure D5: no daemon refusal is added, so A7 holds for the completion route of the day; C8 searches that no daemon code reads results.

findings.finding: No GitHub client call answers whether a commit is on the default branch.

findings.finding: A production result cannot carry new screenshots on a closed issue.
